 How Blackstone Started 
 
 
 
 
 
 Introduction 
 Zack 
Today we'll be diving into Blackstone. Founded in 1985 as a boutique M&A advisory business, with $400,000 seat capital, the firm now manages over $600 billion across private equity, real estate, credit, and hedge fund strategies. In this breakdown, we'll start by discussing Blackstone’s business model, and how it has taken advantage of a structural tailwind in the form of low bond yields.
